faq.title: FAQ – Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1_answer: All adults can register. You can create an account as a buyer, a seller, or both.
faq.q2_question: Can I sell only original LEGO sets?
faq.q2_answer: The marketplace is primarily designed for original LEGO products. Any compatible products must be clearly labeled as such in the description.
faq.q3_answer: The seller sets a starting price and a duration. Buyers place binding bids. When the auction expires, the highest bidder wins, provided the reserve price (if any) is met.
faq.q4_answer: It is the minimum amount the seller is willing to accept. If bids do not reach this amount, the item will not be sold.
faq.q5_answer: If the seller enables it, you can purchase the product immediately at the indicated price, closing the auction.
faq.q6_answer: Payments are handled through secure methods supported by the platform (e.g., Stripe, PayPal).
faq.q7_question: Does the marketplace charge a commission?
faq.q7_answer: Yes, a commission is deducted from each sale, which is visible to the seller before publishing the listing.
faq.q8_answer: Shipping is the seller's responsibility. The buyer will receive tracking information, if available.
faq.q9_question: What should I do if the product arrives damaged?
faq.q9_answer: Contact the seller immediately through the platform. If you cannot reach an agreement, you can open a dispute in the 'Support' section.
faq.q10_answer: Yes, after every transaction, you can leave a truthful and respectful review of the seller.
faq.q11_answer: No, creating multiple accounts to bypass rules or manipulate auctions/reviews is not allowed.
faq.q12_question: How is my personal data handled?
faq.q12_answer: Your data is processed according to the Privacy Policy available on the site, in compliance with current regulations.

legal.title: Legal Rules
legal.subtitle: Terms of use for the LEGO Marketplace platform
legal.art1_body:
1.1 These rules govern access to and use of the online marketplace platform operated by [Company Name / Owner].
1.2 The Platform allows third parties to sell and/or purchase LEGO products, new or used, including via online auctions.
1.3 Access implies full acceptance of these Rules.
legal.art2_body:
2.1 "Seller": user offering products; "Buyer": user purchasing or bidding in auctions; "User": anyone accessing the Platform.
2.2 The Operator provides only the technical infrastructure and is not a party to the sales contracts.
legal.art3_body:
3.1 Use requires creating an account.
3.2 Only adults may register.
3.3 The Operator may suspend accounts that violate these Rules.
legal.art4_body:
4.1 The Seller guarantees the legitimate origin of the products, states whether they are original or compatible, and provides truthful descriptions.
4.2 Selling counterfeit products or using multiple accounts to manipulate auctions is prohibited.
legal.art5_body: 5.1 The Buyer must read the descriptions, act in good faith and provide correct shipping details.
legal.art6_body:
6.1 Bids are binding. The auction ends when the timer expires. If a reserve price is set, the sale is finalized only once it is reached.
6.2 "Shill bidding" (fake bids) is prohibited.
legal.art7_body:
7.1 Payments are made through integrated systems (e.g. Stripe, PayPal).
7.2 The Operator retains a commission, shown before the listing is published.
legal.art8_body:
8.1 The Seller is responsible for shipping.
8.2 The Operator is not liable for damage or delays caused by the carrier.
legal.art10_body: 10.1 The parties must seek an amicable solution. The Operator may act as mediator without assuming liability.
legal.art11_body: 11.1 The Operator does not guarantee the quality or legality of Sellers' products.
legal.art12_body: 12.1 The Operator may amend the Rules at any time, subject to publication.
legal.art13_body:
13.1 These Rules are governed by Italian law.
13.2 Competent court: [City].

how_it_works_page.hero_subtitle: New here? Welcome! CardBrix is the marketplace where collectors of LEGO, Funko Pop and trading cards (Pokémon, Magic, Yu-Gi-Oh, Lorcana, One Piece, Dragon Ball) buy, sell and compete in a safe, verified environment. This page walks you through your first steps.
how_it_works_page.why1_desc: Thousands of LEGO sets, Funko Pops and trading cards, with reference sheets and market values so you always know if a price is fair.
how_it_works_page.why2_desc: Every user has a public profile with verified reviews left by other collectors after each trade, so you always know who you're dealing with.
how_it_works_page.why3_desc: In the Skill Zone you can test your skills in timed challenges and win rare pieces using the credits in your wallet.
how_it_works_page.steps_title: The four steps to get started
how_it_works_page.steps_subtitle: Whether you want to buy, sell or just browse, it always works like this.
how_it_works_page.step1_long_desc: Browse thousands of LEGO, Funko Pop and trading card listings. Search by set number, name or keyword, filter by theme, condition and price, and check the reference catalog with market values to instantly see if an offer is worth it.
how_it_works_page.step2_long_desc: Found what you're looking for? Add it to your cart and buy it instantly at a fixed price, or join a live auction and bid against other collectors down to the last second. Every seller has a profile with verified reviews.
how_it_works_page.step3_long_desc: Got sets or cards you no longer use? Create a free listing in minutes: upload photos, set a price (or start an auction) and reach thousands of collectors. Manage everything from "My Listings" and build your reputation with every sale.
how_it_works_page.step4_long_desc: In the Skill Zone you take on other users in timed games and puzzles: spend credits from your wallet to enter and win rare, hard-to-find pieces as prizes. It's the most fun way to grow your collection.
how_it_works_page.feature1_desc: After every trade you can leave and receive a review: the more sales you complete, the more the community trusts you.
how_it_works_page.feature2_desc: Bids on your auctions, messages and updates on your listings arrive instantly, without needing to refresh the page.
how_it_works_page.feature3_desc: Every collector has a showcase with their listings, average rating and sales history.
how_it_works_page.feature4_desc: Top up your wallet with CardBrix credits: you need them to enter Skill Zone challenges and win prizes.
how_it_works_page.cta_desc: Create a free account and start buying, selling or playing right away.
